title: What does average giving mean?
hook: Two stated cases: explore the population behind a stated average giving fraction.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the population behind a stated average giving fraction affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Added, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the population behind a stated average giving fraction in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
